title: Specify and validate Network-derived fracture-set sampling inputs
description: Add focused pure helpers/data model in fractopo.interop.porepy (or its closest existing home) to extract usable named fracture sets from Network.trace_data / trace_gdf. Require default dip and dip_direction columns, numeric finite dip [0,90] and dip_direction [0,360], positive finite lengths, and a named azimuth-set label. Exclude NULL_SET and invalid/incomplete set samples; renormalize trace-count proportions; fail clearly if no usable set remains. Preserve sampled trace azimuth and dip pairing; generated dip direction is derived from sampled azimuth using right-hand-rule strike/dip convention. Do not introduce parametric fitting in this slice.

title: Generate PorePy 3D circular-fracture populations from Network data
description: Deliver a direct PorePy 3D CSV export of a specified number of circular fractures in a supplied cuboid. Source a fractopo.analysis.network.Network: use configured/manual or automatic azimuth-set labels and observed named-set trace-count proportions; take observed dip and dip_direction from trace_gdf columns; empirically sample orientation and trace length per set; place centres uniformly in the cuboid; emit PorePy domain plus 8-field elliptic-fracture rows. Decisions captured 2026-08-21: use trace azimuth as generated strike, derive dip direction by right-hand rule; exclude NULL_SET and invalid/incomplete set samples and renormalize; optional numpy.random.Generator; sampled trace length maps to PorePy semi-axis length / 2. Correct all current 3D exporters to the same semi-axis semantics.

title: Test and document Network-to-PorePy random fracture export
description: Add small deterministic pytest coverage for the Network-based generator: supplied Generator reproducibility; exact total and per-set allocated counts; usable-set proportions from trace counts; exclusion/renormalization of NULL_SET/invalid samples; uniform centres bounded by supplied cuboid; output PorePy domain plus 8-field rows; correct semi-axis = trace length / 2; generated strike tracks sampled Network azimuth and dip is sampled empirically. Add API documentation/example explaining Network requirements (dip/dip_direction columns), centre-only boundary guarantee, empirical sampling, PorePy import invocation, and why fitted powerlaw distributions are intentionally not sampled in this initial path.

title: Export seeded random circular fractures from a Network into PorePy 3D CSV
description: Implement public Network-based CSV generator in fractopo.interop.porepy. Inputs: Network, positive fracture count, six-value cuboid bounds, optional numpy.random.Generator, default trace_gdf columns dip/dip_direction. Allocate exact per-set counts from usable trace-count proportions via a documented deterministic rounding method. Sample each set empirically (with replacement) from its valid observations; place each centre uniformly in [xmin,xmax] etc.; set circular axes to sampled trace length / 2; use major_axis_angle=0; output a six-value PorePy domain first then rows CENTER_X,CENTER_Y,CENTER_Z,MAJOR_AXIS,MINOR_AXIS,MAJOR_AXIS_ANGLE,STRIKE_ANGLE,DIP_ANGLE. Guarantee centres only (not full disks) lie in bounds. No PorePy runtime dependency.

title: Correct PorePy 3D axis semantics and validate generated CSV
description: PorePy EllipticFracture r1/r2 are radius-like semi-axes. Correct existing export_traces_to_porepy_3d_csv_format and export_structural_measurements_to_porepy_3d_csv_format so their length input is written as axis length / 2, update docs/tests accordingly, and avoid inconsistent generator behavior. Add a 3D CSV format check shared by exports: optional six-field cuboid domain line and then numeric eight-field elliptic fracture rows. Validate finite centres, positive equal axes for circular fractures, and radians/rows as appropriate without adding PorePy as a fractopo dependency.
